program.intent: Convert syslog timestamp with month, day, and time into a packed integer and back.
program.code:
def forward(groups):
    month, sp1, day, sp2, time = groups
    text = month + ' ' + day + ' ' + time
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%b %d %H:%M:%S')
    return {'stored': [dt.hour * 3600 + dt.minute * 60 + dt.second], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(sp2), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    seconds = int(record['stored'][0])
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len, sp2_len, day_width = layout
    hour = seconds // 3600
    minute = (seconds % 3600) // 60
    second = seconds % 60
    dt = datetime(1900, 1, 1, hour, minute, second)
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    day = str(dt.day).zfill(day_width)
    time = dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    return month + (' ' * sp1_len) + day + (' ' * sp2_len) + time
